prior_attempt.meaning: Inventory assertion expected 4 objects; producer actually emits eight (16MiB+4MiB per file). No measured read occurred; error and corrected tools retained.

supported_claim: With a different cold object HEAD deliberately delayed by 250ms, an independently opened read of an unread frame from an already complete local object also waits until the HEAD is released, in all three bounded trials. The source holds the shared registry mutex across HEAD.
limits: This is a controlled stall reproduction, not ordinary latency, throughput, a fix comparison, or attribution of the formal cold-readdir regression.
The stored B object was removed by cleanup. Independent review verifies recorded size/digest/fragment assertions and deterministic content hashes; it cannot re-read that deleted physical file.
Separate preopened never-read FDs, unique offsets, decode/logical deltas, and zero B network events substantiate the intended local read path.
All budgets remain explicit as in the formal experiment; this is not a default-budget pressure test.
This supplemental diagnosis does not revise the user-authorized overall-E2E acceptance decision.
